title: Three Seasons and One Short Flag
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：match　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 match 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the player ① played the match that no fan in the field would have recorded, and he said the playing was the whole of the season. The ② match, meaning the game itself and not the flag, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a match, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ match in that field had the same short flag beside it, and the ④ match at the far stand, meaning the goal they kept for the children to remember and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A match, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the player said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the match was the whole of the matter, meaning the rivalry and not the game. The ⑥ match, meaning the rivalry and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; match, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a game and a rivalry. He said the rivalry is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ match had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short flag. The ⑧ match of the whole thing, the player wrote in June, was one field and three seasons of recording; match, he said, is either the goal at the far stand or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ match I remember is the game recorded in the report, which closed in 1983 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ match, my mother said in 1985, is the only game that improves by being recorded; every match, she said, is a rivalry that has agreed to look like a game. She said the rivalry was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 比赛；竞赛（指球场里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 比赛；竞赛（指那场比赛本身，与角旗相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the match 打这场比赛
D. n. 比赛；竞赛（指留给孩子们记住的那一球那一场）
E. n. 赛事之事（抽象总称，指一处球场的比赛之事）
F. n. 比赛；竞赛（指赛事记录里写到、被记载的的那一场）
G. n. 较量、胜负（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 胜负（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the match that no fan in the field would have recorded
The match, meaning the game itself and not the flag
the match at the far stand

answers.why: play the match 意为“打这场比赛”，1976 年那位球员把球场里没有一位球迷肯记载的一场比赛做了一遍。
match 意为“比赛；竞赛”，指那场比赛本身而不是角旗，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被记载。
match 意为“比赛；竞赛”，指球场里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一面小小的角旗。
match 意为“比赛；竞赛”，指最远那面看台留给孩子们记住的那一球那一场，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
match 意为“较量、胜负”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场较量就是那件事的全部。
match 意为“胜负”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场比赛，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
match 意为“比赛；竞赛”，指赛事记录里写到、被记载的的那一场，到 1981 年这一场成了赛事记录里的一行。
match 意为“赛事之事”，球员六月写道，整件事的比赛之事是一处球场和三个赛季的记载。
match 意为“比赛；竞赛”，我记得的是赛事记录里记载过的那一场，1983 年打完了，至今仍被说成球场里最安静的一场。
match 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，比赛是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的比赛。
